source_policy: Use local taxonomy cache, project documentation and controlled annotations only; STRING and UniProt are placeholders marked not_queried.
controlled_data_policy: Functional annotations are representative controlled fixtures with limited confidence and explicit notes.
relation_to_scoring: No scoring input, weight or ranking output is changed by this snapshot.
relation_to_pipeline: The snapshot is a reproducibility artifact and offline validation fixture; it is not integrated into runtime layer resolution.
limitations: Not a complete Corynebacterium pseudotuberculosis pangenome or virulome.
This is a generic controlled example and awaits any user-supplied organism-specific data.
future_refresh_protocol: Define organism and optional strain identifiers before external refresh.
Run taxonomy, STRING and UniProt only under an explicit online_optional validation protocol.
Freeze source manifests and checksums after human review.
Keep fresh external evidence separate from controlled scaffolds.
